name: claude-usage-statusbar
description: Shows live Session and Weekly Claude Code usage % (from Anthropic's usage API) with colored progress bars.

claudeUsage.credentialsPath.description: Path to the Claude Code OAuth credentials file (read locally; the token is sent only to api.anthropic.com). User/machine setting only — workspace settings cannot override it.

claudeUsage.refreshBaseSeconds.description: Base idle poll interval (seconds; min 15). Each poll is jittered by ±refreshJitterPct so clients de-synchronize. With syncToActivity on, refreshes are mainly driven by request activity; this timer just catches resets/idle.

claudeUsage.refreshJitterPct.description: Random jitter applied to refreshBaseSeconds as a ± fraction (0.2 = ±20%, so a 90s base polls every ~72–108s). Max 0.5.

claudeUsage.backoffMedianFirstSeconds.description: Median first-retry delay (seconds) for the decorrelated-jitter (Polly V2) backoff after a failed usage call. Later retries grow smoothly toward backoffCapSeconds; a 429 Retry-After header is honored as a floor.

claudeUsage.backoffCapSeconds.description: Maximum backoff window (seconds) after repeated failures. A 429 response's Retry-After is always honored as a floor.

claudeUsage.startupSplaySeconds.description: Randomize the first poll after activation by 0–N seconds, so many windows/clients starting at once (or reopening after an outage) don't all hit the API simultaneously.

claudeUsage.barSegments.description: Number of segments in each progress bar.

claudeUsage.warnThreshold.description: Percent at which the gauge turns yellow.

claudeUsage.highThreshold.description: Percent at which the gauge turns orange (warning background).

claudeUsage.criticalThreshold.description: Percent at which the gauge turns red (error background).

claudeUsage.betaHeader.description: Value of the anthropic-beta header required by the OAuth usage endpoint. User/machine setting only — workspace settings cannot override it.

claudeUsage.syncToActivity.description: Refresh usage shortly after real Claude Code request activity (detected locally from ~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl log writes) instead of only on the timer.

claudeUsage.activityPollSeconds.description: How often to check the Claude Code logs locally for new activity (seconds). This is a local file stat only; it never calls the usage API.

claudeUsage.activityDebounceSeconds.description: How long to wait after the last logged request before refreshing usage (randomized up to 2× so multiple windows don't refresh in lockstep), so a burst of requests triggers a single refresh.

claudeUsage.activityMinIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum gap between activity-triggered usage API calls, to protect the rate limit during heavy use. Also how long a usage snapshot fetched by another window is reused instead of calling the API again.

claudeUsage.showResetGauge.description: Show the 'resets in' sand-timer gauge (hourglass + draining braille cells) next to each usage bar. The exact time remaining is in the hover tooltip.

claudeUsage.sessionWindowHours.description: Length of the Session window in hours (used to compute how much time is left for the reset gauge).

claudeUsage.weeklyWindowDays.description: Length of the Weekly window in days (used to compute how much time is left for the reset gauge).
